# Order Vehicle Management System (OVMS)

Order Vehicle Management System (OVMS) is a dashboard application for managing vehicle orders, assignments, driver availability, and real-time monitoring of fleet requests.

## Main Routes and Pages

- [/login](file:///login) - Authentication page for all roles.
- [/admin/dashboard](file:///admin/dashboard) - Dashboard for system administrators, showcasing analytics on vehicle usage, driver status, and active schedules.
- [/admin/vehicles](file:///admin/vehicles) - Manage vehicle inventory, availability, and status.
- [/admin/drivers](file:///admin/drivers) - Manage drivers, licenses, and assignments.
- [/admin/requests](file:///admin/requests) - Monitor and dispatch fleet requests.
- [/admin/users](file:///admin/users) - Manage system users and role assignments.
- [/admin/settings](file:///admin/settings) - Global system settings and logo uploads.
- [/employee/dashboard](file:///employee/dashboard) - Dashboard for requesting employees.
- [/driver/dashboard](file:///driver/dashboard) - Dashboard for drivers to view schedules and assignments.
- [/approver/dashboard](file:///approver/dashboard) - Dashboard for department heads/managers to approve vehicle requests.
- [/gahrd/dashboard](file:///gahrd/dashboard) - GA & HRD dashboard for request monitoring and dispatcher tools.
- [/security/dashboard](file:///security/dashboard) - Dashboard for security officers to scan and log vehicle trips.

## Key APIs

- `/api/auth` - Login, registration, and profile management.
- `/api/requests` - CRUD for fleet requests and approval flows.
- `/api/vehicles` - Retrieve and update vehicle information.
- `/api/users` - Retrieve and manage users/drivers.
- `/api/settings` - Global configurations.
